title: What is the area of each triangle in the rectangle?
description: A diagonal cuts a seven centimetre by four centimetre rectangle into two triangles that fit exactly on each other. Half of the rectangle's area gives the area of each triangle. Keeko doubts this and says each triangle has the whole rectangle's area.
teaching_notes: One idea: a diagonal splits a rectangle into two congruent triangles, so each has half the area of the rectangle. Watch for children who give each triangle the area of the whole rectangle.

source: A diagonal is drawn in a 7 cm by 4 cm rectangle. Find the ar
video_script.why: The child sees that two congruent triangles share the rectangle's area equally, so each is half of length times width.
video_script.substitution: Find the rectangle's area, then take half of it for each congruent triangle.
video_script.anchor: the rectangle of the book with its diagonal, seven centimetres long and four centimetres wide
video_script.wrong_answer: each triangle is twenty eight square centimetres
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko gives each triangle the area of the whole rectangle. Sliding the two triangles together shows 28 cm² is the area of both together.
video_script.payoff_line: each triangle has an area of fourteen square centimetres
never_show: the area of one triangle, before the answer beat
maths_rules: rectangle 7 cm by 4 cm: area 7 × 4 = 28 cm²
the diagonal makes two congruent triangles, so each is half the rectangle
the two triangles together: 14 + 14 = 28 cm², the whole rectangle
video_script.design: One idea: a diagonal halves a rectangle. Wrong idea: each triangle takes the whole area. The rectangle with its diagonal stays on stage from the hook to the end.

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='rect'/>A rectangle is seven centimetres long and four centimetres wide.
<bookmark mark='diag'/>A line from one corner to the opposite corner is called a diagonal.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>What is the area of each triangle that the diagonal makes?

beats.on_screen: the rectangle with its diagonal and the question stay on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: one triangle lifts, turns half way round and lies exactly on the other triangle, then goes back

marks.cut: the two triangles pull slightly apart
marks.turn: one triangle turns half way round and lies on the other

beats.colours: two distinct fills for the two triangles
narration: <bookmark mark='cut'/>The diagonal cuts the rectangle into two triangles.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Turn one triangle half way round and it lies exactly on the other.
<bookmark mark='same'/>Shapes that fit exactly on each other are called congruent.

beats.on_screen: Given: rectangle 7 cm by 4 cm with a diagonal
narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, a rectangle seven centimetres by four centimetres, with a diagonal drawn.

beats.on_screen: To find: the area of each triangle

marks.find: the words to find are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the area of each triangle.

beats.on_screen: Area of a rectangle = length × width = 7 × 4 = 28 cm²
narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Step one, use area of a rectangle equals length times width.
<bookmark mark='values'/>Seven times four gives twenty eight square centimetres for the whole rectangle.

beats.on_screen: The two triangles are congruent, so each is half of the rectangle

marks.half: the words each is half of the rectangle are written

narration: <bookmark mark='half'/>Step two, the two triangles are congruent, so they share the area equally.
Each triangle is half of the rectangle.
<bookmark mark='take'/>Step three, take half of the rectangle's area.
Half of seven times four is half of twenty eight.

beats.on_screen: Answer: each triangle has an area of 14 cm²

marks.ans: the answer is boxed with its units

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Each triangle has an area of fourteen square centimetres.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the rectangle and its two triangles
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: a bubble shows 28 cm² beside one triangle; the two triangles slide together to make the whole rectangle; the bubble is crossed out in the warning colour

marks.doubt: the bubble shows 28 cm² beside one triangle
marks.join: the two triangles slide together into the whole rectangle
marks.fix: the bubble is crossed out and 14 cm² appears on each triangle

beats.colours: warning colour on the crossed bubble
narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks each triangle is twenty eight square centimetres, because it uses the whole rectangle.
<bookmark mark='join'/>Slide the two triangles together and they make the whole rectangle again.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Twenty eight is the area of both triangles together, and each one has half of it.
